title: KKE ImGui Demo
description: A dedicated demo for Dear ImGui: wraps ImGui's own built-in ShowDemoWindow(), the library's canonical showcase of every widget type it supports (buttons, sliders, color pickers, drag/drop, tables, trees, tabs, menus, popups, text editing, plotting, and more), against a minimal grid + orbit-camera backdrop.

requirements.notes: Best-effort, developer-declared estimates -- see README 'Estimated hardware requirements'. This demo is UI-only content; the 3D backdrop (grid) is trivial to render.
